title: PCSS Herald Envelope
description: Notification and reporting envelope. Emitted by Lens / Aegis / Notary consumers and routed to parent, regulator, or civil-society subscribers. See PCSS §7.

herald_id.description: Stable, opaque identifier for this herald envelope.

cadence.description: The cadence under which this envelope is being delivered. 'immediate' MUST be used for Aegis hard-block events; 'daily' for privacy events; 'weekly' for aggregate usage.

events.description: The events being heralded. Each event references a receipt (for verdict events) or a bearing/threshold ID (for state-change events).

event_type.description: Canonical event type. 'verdict:block' / 'verdict:allow' for Lens/Aegis decisions; 'threshold:granted' / 'threshold:revoked' for consent state; 'custody:deleted' for data deletion confirmations; 'bearing:rotated' for age signal rotations.

receipt_id.description: Reference to a Notary receipt for verdict events.

bearing_id.description: Opaque reference. Herald envelopes MUST NOT carry user-identifying data beyond the opaque ID.

summary.description: Human-readable single-line summary. Required for the 'parent' surface; optional for regulator/civil-society.

issued_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the herald envelope was emitted.

subscriber.description: Registered identifier of the recipient (e.g., 'regulator:us-ftc', 'civil-society:commonsense', 'parent:opaque-handle'). MUST be omitted on parent-surface envelopes that carry user-identifying delivery routing in transport metadata.
